text_block_list.text: The Hopeful Stakes—The Day Before.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, pant!*
...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: How... was it?

A form that made full use of a wide range of motion.
Breathing that quickly stabilized. Her time for the final 3 furlongs
had set a new personal record.

"It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say
this is the highest peak she could possibly reach right now."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
It's all thanks to everyone.

I nodded deeply at her words.
The plan we started that day has been progressing smoothly, just as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I must prove it in the race, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...And I pray
that this reaches Flash-san's heart."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You mean tomorrow's Hopeful Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes,
would you please come watch it live at the track?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I had planned on spending that time spectating
anyway, so it is no trouble. But, why...?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want Flash-san to see
what I have gained.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: “What I gained”...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What on earth is Pisa-san doing...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Now then, I wonder what it could be.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...!
Were you two invited by Pisa-san as well?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not the case.
However, our gathering here was not coincidence, but inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Think of this as a showcase.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the Hopeful Stakes with a special, one-day-only deck—
that's how the game begins.
